posts.author: Cyanide
posts.body:
Hey!
To get the most out of the following rtp edits and tilesets  use them for parallax mapping.
If you still like to use them with the editor you might need to rearrange some of it.
Terms to use:
You must own a legal version of RPG Maker MV to use these edits and the credit goes to Kadokawa if not mentioned otherwise.
You may be use the following tilesets and edits for non commercial and commercial use if not mentioned otherwise.
If you use the following tilesets and edits kindly credit me, Cyanide. You do not have to credit me for screenshots/mockups or all kind of images that includes my tilesets on this board. But I highly appreciate it to mention me when usig my tilesets and icons outside of the community e.g. Youtube etc.
You may edit following tilesets and edits as you like as long you credit me for the base. If you like to post edits of my work, kindly let me know.
You are not allowed to post my tilesets somewhere else without my permission but you can link to this thread.
Optional, I would be glad to see what you did with the tilesets
Send me screenshots, videos, demos or whatever!
If you have some suggestions/ideas/requests or see something that need to be fixed or edited kindly inform me and I will try my best to help soon.

This must be an odd question to ask, but can these tile-sets
only
be used with RPG Maker?

posts.author: Kes
posts.body:
@Monology
As the opening post says, these are edits of the RTP of MV.  They can only, therefore be used if you legally own MV and cannot be used in any engine that is not RPG Maker published by Degica.

posts.author: Monology
posts.body: Ah, okay. I didn't really understand what "edits" meant at first, but I do now. Thanks.

Thank you for your interest. My intention was to provide something for the RPG Maker Community.
Regarding the Tilesets the ones in the spoiler "RTP Edits" are
only
to be used with RPG Maker, because it is almost entirely based on the RTP.
The other two spoiler "boxes" do contain tilesets wich are mostly not based on the RTP with a handful exceptions. You can PM me for details.

Hey!
To get the most out of the following rtp edits and tilesets  use them for parallax mapping.
If you still like to use them with the editor you might need to rearrange some of it.
Terms to use:
You must own a legal version of RPG Maker MV to use these edits and the credit goes to Kadokawa if not mentioned otherwise.
You may be use the following tilesets and edits for non commercial and commercial use if not mentioned otherwise.
If you use the following tilesets and edits kindly credit me, Cyanide. You do not have to credit me for screenshots/mockups or all kind of images that includes my tilesets on this board. But I highly appreciate it to mention me when usig my tilesets and icons outside of the community e.g. Youtube etc.
You may edit following tilesets and edits as you like as long you credit me for the base. If you like to post edits of my work, kindly let me know.
You are not allowed to post my tilesets somewhere else without my permission but you can link to this thread.
Optional, I would be glad to see what you did with the tilesets
Send me screenshots, videos, demos or whatever!
If you have some suggestions/ideas/requests or see something that need to be fixed or edited kindly inform me and I will try my best to help soon.
